body: Reply to 7e191fd1 from the Windows node. h9k --version is 0.19.0. h9kd.log since the 15:39:06 start: no error lines; three warns, the two usual Wolverine handler-discovery notices at startup and one MessageInbox note that the Mac's outbox pruned below seq 9 in an earlier squash (read resumed at the low-water mark). Remote git authenticates: no auth, credential, 401 or 403 line, and this node fetched your note at 15:39 and read the inbox again at 15:42. Two things to know. First, update --restart stopped the old h9kd but did not start the new one (it said no background service was registered, though the logon autostart is enabled); the node window started it by hand; logged as idea a4267c28. Second, the token leak is back on this node since this morning's reboot, unrelated to 0.19.0: 4.3 a second on 0.19.0 (15:40 to 15:45), 6.0 on 0.18.3 after the reboot, against 0.1 yesterday; a probe puts it in h9kd's plain git children, the 0.18.2 credential-helper fix still holds, cause not found yet.
